plugins.description: ecoctx audits the context your coding agent loads on every turn - CLAUDE.md, indexes, every installed skill's description - and measures what each costs in tokens. It ranks what can really be changed, then grades each prediction against what the fix actually bought. Sixteen steps, two phases, and a record another person can check.

skills.name: ecoctx
skills.description: Audit what a coding agent loads on every turn — instruction files, indexes, skill descriptions — rank what can actually be changed, then grade each prediction against what it bought. Use when the user asks why a session starts expensive, wants an always-loaded instruction file cut down, asks what loads every turn or what a skill costs to have installed, wants per-session context cost measured, or wants an earlier audit's findings graded. Phase 2 runs after the fixes exist, not at ranking.
